public_body: Brookline 9Th School Ad Hoc Subcommittee Of The Advisory Committee
overall: Bodies were found to have complied on the executive session purposes, procedure, minutes release and minutes accuracy, but violated the law by omitting the affected property from the September 12 and 19, 2017 notices; the AG ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the joint executive sessions lacked a valid Purpose 3 (litigation) or Purpose 6 (real property) basis, with no pending litigation or ongoing negotiation.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that they were within the scope of Purpose 6.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the joint meeting notices failed to identify the real property to be discussed in executive session under Purpose 6.
allegations.key_passage: Because we find that identifying the property under discussion would not have compromised the negotiating positions of the bodies following the September 5, 2017 phone call, the omission of this information from the September 12 and 19, 2017 notices violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Committee and Subcommittee chairs did not make required statements or take proper votes before convening in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: our review leads us to conclude that the bodies complied with the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the bodies waived the right to withhold September executive session minutes by public disclosure and by reviewing the minutes in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Because the minutes discussed during the October 24, 2017 meeting remain protected from disclosure by their respective executive session purposes, the Subcommittee is not required to release them now.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged Committee and Subcommittee minutes omitted the chair's pre-executive-session statement and pre-executive-session votes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the final minutes as approved meet the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, we find no violation with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: A request for further review alleged the Board and Committee failed to approve minutes timely; this allegation was not in the underlying complaints.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation is not found in any of the complaints filed with the

remedy: We order the bodies' immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the bodies' immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
